bio.text: Shawn Still, a Republican, has served in the Georgia State Senate since 2022, representing Senate District 48.
According to his legislative biography, Still is from Johns Creek and graduated from the University of Alabama with a B.A.
The biography says he is president of Olympic Pool Plastering and Shotcrete and a past president of the Pool and Hot Tub Alliance.
